Let \(n=2017\) and \(x=\frac{\pi}{2018}\), so \((n+1)x=\pi\). Put \(y=\cos x\).

\[
f(x)=\sum_{k=1}^{2017}\frac{\cos kx}{y^k}
=\Re\sum_{k=1}^{2017}\left(\frac{e^{ix}}y\right)^k.
\]

Let \(r=\frac{e^{ix}}y\). Then

\[
\sum_{k=1}^{n}r^k=\frac{r^{n+1}-r}{r-1}
=\frac{\frac{e^{i(n+1)x}}{y^{n+1}}-\frac{e^{ix}}y}{\frac{e^{ix}}y-1}
=\frac{\frac{e^{i\pi}}{y^n}-e^{ix}}{e^{ix}-y}.
\]

Since \(e^{i\pi}=-1\), \(e^{ix}=\cos x+i\sin x=y+i\sin x\),

\[
\sum_{k=1}^{n}r^k
=\frac{-\frac1{y^n}-(y+i\sin x)}{i\sin x}
=i\frac{1/y^n+y}{\sin x}-1.
\]

Taking the real part:

\[
f\left(\frac{\pi}{2018}\right)=-1.
\]

\[
\boxed{-1}
\]
